page.overview:
What is Hassika V?

Hassika V was the planet where Empress Habla Corrino was born.

It was mentioned as the home planet of origin of Habla during the negotiations between her son, Crown Prince Shaddam, and the Bene Gesserit representative, Margot Rashino-Zea.

Because of the ascension of Habla as Empress and wife of Emperor Elrood IX, the Ecazi Revolt took place.
